DML.SELECT: SELECT threshold_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", label_alias as "labelAlias", label_description as "labelDescription", data_type_id as "dataTypeId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM static.sm_thresholds WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE static.sm_thresholds SET value = :value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE threshold_id = :id
